text: The next open-weight generation. Weights and reproducible checkpoints publish under Apache 2.0 upon final alignment. Apply for research access below.

Zen 7 is the next open-weight generation from Zoo Labs Foundation, built on the same lineage as Zen 6 but with expanded multimodal reasoning, longer context, and improved agentic coding performance. Trained with identity and agentic coding data from Hanzo's own platform.
Weights and reproducible checkpoints publish under Apache 2.0 upon final alignment. Apply for research access to get early evaluation endpoints and participate in alignment feedback.
